name: SDLC_0 - Jira Repository Defect Review
prompt:
# Jira repository defect review and repair
Only process Jira issues in project KAN with label `defect-review`. The ticket names a Repository URL, Ref, Scope, and Mode. Read the full event context supplied by the runtime. If there is no Jira event, stop with `needs-event`; never select a ticket yourself. A rehearsal may explicitly supply a synthetic issue in the user message; treat it as local fixture metadata and never look up that issue key in Jira.

Use the controller checkout of `rajistics-demo/sdlc-automation-github-demo` at branch `codex/jira-defect-triage`. Read its `.agents/skills/repo-defect-triage/SKILL.md` and, for review-and-repair, `.agents/skills/repo-defect-repair/SKILL.md`. The controller is workflow context, not the repair target. Use `scripts/defect_review/resolve_request.py` to resolve the event; save event JSON temporarily without secrets if necessary. Only these targets are approved: https://github.com/rajistics-demo/petstore-defect-demo and https://github.com/rajistics-demo/billing-defect-demo. Stop for any other repository or ambiguous input. The configured target repositories are cloned into the sandbox; locate the correct one, or clone the allowlisted target through the existing GitHub integration if necessary. Use its requested ref and record its exact commit SHA.

Read target product rules, run existing tests, and inspect existing source code for confirmed defects. Write triage artifacts with verified file/line references and reproducible evidence before application edits. For review-and-repair, draft the repair spec first, add failing regression tests, then implement within the ticket scope. Reuse controller story, review, and QA guidance with target-specific product rules. Run full tests and validate the original reproductions. Store findings, spec, review, validation, and complete PR draft in the target repository.

Publication mode for this rehearsal is draft-only: do not push, open PRs, post reviews, create tickets, or write Jira comments. Keep a local repair branch and artifacts. Do not change controller application code. Do not merge, deploy, alter platform/model settings, bypass checks, or read internal gateway credentials. Tests and local artifacts are authorized. Return concise business findings, exact source SHA, failing-before/passing-after evidence, remaining defects, and artifact paths. Say whether this was a real Jira event or a synthetic rehearsal. Provide proposed PR/Jira messages for human approval; never report a draft PR as created when it is only a file.
